title: Real Deployment Environment
scope: Harden the local/demo Docker Compose stack toward a reproducible production-like deployment: verify env-var config, secrets hygiene, health checks, service dependencies, migration startup, graceful shutdown, restart behavior, log hygiene; add optional local/demo TLS termination on the frontend where infrastructure genuinely permits it.

implementation.new_capability: Optional local/demo TLS termination on the frontend nginx container, selected at container startup based on certificate presence; default plain-HTTP behavior fully unaffected.
components: deployment/tls/generate_local_cert.sh (new) - self-signed cert generator, local/demo only
frontend/nginx.tls.conf (new) - HTTPS server block + HTTP->HTTPS redirect template
frontend/nginx.conf (unchanged content, comment updated) - default HTTP-only config
frontend/docker-entrypoint-tls.sh (new) - idempotent config selection on every container start
frontend/Dockerfile (modified) - stages both configs, wires new entrypoint, TLS-aware healthcheck
docker-compose.yml (modified) - FRONTEND_TLS_PORT mapping, tls volume mount, TLS-aware healthcheck
reused_from_prior_phases: Prisma/Alembic explicit migration policy (documented P7.10/11_DEPLOYMENT.md) - unchanged, re-verified

failures_found_and_fixed.description: Windows Git-Bash/MSYS path-mangling of openssl -subj argument
failures_found_and_fixed.root_cause: MSYS auto-converts leading-slash CLI arguments into Windows paths
failures_found_and_fixed.fix: export MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 and MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL=* before the openssl call; no-op on real Linux/macOS

failures_found_and_fixed.description: HTTP->HTTPS redirect targeted the implicit default port 443 instead of the actual host-mapped 8443
failures_found_and_fixed.root_cause: nginx has no knowledge of Docker's external port mapping
failures_found_and_fixed.fix: templated __TLS_PORT__ placeholder substituted via sed at container startup from FRONTEND_TLS_PORT

failures_found_and_fixed.description: Healthcheck failed when TLS active because it always probed plain HTTP unconditionally
failures_found_and_fixed.root_cause: Dockerfile HEALTHCHECK and compose healthcheck: (which overrides it) were not TLS-aware
failures_found_and_fixed.fix: both checks now branch on certificate-file presence, wget --no-check-certificate for HTTPS case (safe, container-internal loopback only)

failures_found_and_fixed.description: Non-idempotent entrypoint across docker compose restart: removing a previously-mounted cert and restarting crashed the container into a restart loop
failures_found_and_fixed.root_cause: docker compose restart reuses the same container's writable filesystem layer; the entrypoint's no-cert branch never actively restored the plain-HTTP config, only printed a message, assuming default.conf was already in its as-built state
failures_found_and_fixed.fix: staged an immutable copy of the original HTTP-only config (nginx.http.conf) at a fixed path in the image; the no-cert branch now explicitly cp's it into conf.d/default.conf on every single start regardless of prior state
failures_found_and_fixed.note: most significant defect found this phase; full bidirectional cycle re-verified after fix

failures_found_and_fixed.description: intelligence/device_ai local .venv missing cryptography, grpcio, protobuf (all pinned in requirements.txt for the P6.2 Fabric Gateway client)
failures_found_and_fixed.root_cause: stale local venv, not a repository defect; a blind pip install -r requirements.txt triggered an unrelated numpy source-rebuild failure (no prebuilt numpy 2.2.1 wheel for Python 3.14)
failures_found_and_fixed.fix: installed the three pinned packages directly (all had prebuilt Windows wheels); left the already-installed numpy 2.5.1 untouched
failures_found_and_fixed.note: environment-sync fix, not a code change; restored full 1121-test suite to a runnable, passing state

Unchanged from P8; no peer/orderer/CA binaries or channel artifacts exist. Addressed in depth in P9.2.

environmental_limitations.item: Unified reverse proxy across the whole stack (single origin for frontend+backend+device-ai)
environmental_limitations.detail: Deliberately scoped out — would require reworking CORS/VITE_API_BASE_URL and rewriting already-hardened P7.5/P8.7 architecture for no P9.1-mandated benefit. The narrower optional-TLS-on-frontend implementation fully satisfies P9.1's own conditional instruction.
